_comment: Copy to engine.json and fill in. Brand-level wiring: what you're making, where it files. engine.json is gitignored — it is yours, not the template's.
_comment_creators: One brand, N creators. 'folder' is the local working folder where video folders live. 'drive_subpath' is the chain under the Brands folder in Drive.
_comment_db: The spreadsheet that holds your reference-video Database tab. Create it, then paste its id from the URL: docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<THIS PART>/edit
_comment_columns: 0-based column indexes into the Database tab. Defaults match the slim schema: A=Thumbnail B=Link C=Brand D=Platform E=Transcript F=Type G=Creator, H+ = storyboard frames.
_comment_captions: Leave captions_sheet_id null to use the master DB spreadsheet.
_comment_drive: drive_root_id is the Drive folder everything is created under — open the folder and copy the id from the URL. drive_path is the folder chain for working docs; {year} and {month} are filled at run time.
